title: Central mailbox authority transiently 'not durable': session list refused 409 twice, recovers by itself
outcome: It is established from source and available diagnostics what sets federation_durable false on a healthy Central and how long it stays false, and whether that explains the transient relay failures. Any confirmed defect is fixed in its owning mechanism; otherwise the disposition and remaining unknown cause are recorded.
acceptance: A source trace names every path that clears federation_durable and every path that restores it, and states which of them can fire during ordinary operation on a healthy Central.
The refusal's relationship to the transient relay 503s and 423s in w-d55fadb8c0b2 is stated with evidence, or recorded as unknown. No cause is claimed from timing alone.

If a defect is confirmed: a behaviour test that fails before the fix, the fix in the owning mechanism with no weakening of durability or authority checks, a review pair with no Medium or higher, and the normal gate. If not: a bounded no-change disposition naming what evidence is missing.
